verdict.rationale: Undermind lets a researcher shape a run's scope before it starts by answering its follow-up questions. A similar resubmitted search continues from existing results, which effectively extends depth. However, the deep-research tool decides its own effort and stopping point ('stops only when new searches stop finding relevant papers'), and nothing documents a user-set depth or effort level or steering while a run executes. Missing for 10: explicit depth/effort controls, mid-run steering or interruption, scope filters documented for the deep-research run itself, independent hands-on confirmation of steering.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can steer the depth, effort, and scope of a research run before or while it executes

citations.quote: Undermind asks follow-up questions to understand exactly what you need.
Resubmitting a similar search continues from existing results
Plans its own searches, follows citations and key authors, and stops only when new searches stop finding relevant papers.
